First drop-in release of DS3 VR: native-stereo VR for Dark Souls III on top of Helifax's geo-11 fix.

**Install**
1. Download `Dark_Souls_3_geo11_fix.7z` from [Helifax's fix page](https://helixmod.blogspot.com/2016/04/dark-souls-3-3d-vision-fix.html) and put it in the game's `Game` folder (the one with `DarkSoulsIII.exe`). No need to extract it.
2. Download `DS3VR-0.10.0.zip` below and extract all of it into the same `Game` folder.
3. Run `install-ds3vr.bat`. This step exists only because geo-11 and Helifax's fix cannot be included in this download: it unpacks Helifax's fix, backs up every file it changes, switches geo-11 to VR output and sets the game's graphics options for VR.
4. Start your VR runtime, then launch Dark Souls III from Steam.

Full instructions are in `ds3vr\README.txt` in the zip. To remove it, run `uninstall-ds3vr.bat`.

**In this version**
- Drop-in install: extract into the Game folder and run `install-ds3vr.bat` (replaces the old setup .exe)
- Until the install step has run, the mod stays off and says what to do
- Resolution readout in the VR menu: what the game renders now, what your VR runtime asks for, and what the next launch will use
- Works with any OpenXR runtime (SteamVR, Virtual Desktop VDXR, Meta, PimaxXR), including runtimes chosen per launch and headsets with angled displays
- Fixed: occasional crash or scrambled view on the first launch of a session
- Steadier view when turning your head (pose lag 2, head movement follows world scale)
